scenario: [LEXP.7.14.1]: `5 >> 64` is 0 -- a non-negative value shifted right by 64 or more. Masked, it reads `5 >> 0` = 5. Guard `(t.x >> t.n) == 0`; fact_count 2 confirms it fired.
rules_ds:
schema T scope logical:
    x: Int key
    n: Int key

schema Hit scope logical:
    d: Int key

rule r:
    T t where (t.x >> t.n) == 0
->
    emit Hit logical d: 0
